title: Create Company — Guide
subtitle: A read-only training walkthrough with sample data and field explanations
demoBanner: Training mode — the data on this page is sample data shown for demonstration only. This form saves nothing and every control is disabled.

labels.howTo: How do I fill it in?
labels.realControlNote: The real control for this section is shown below, in read-only mode.

quickStart.title: What does this page do?
quickStart.intro: The «Create Company» page registers a new company:
steps: You enter the company's basic info: Persian name, registration date, registration number, national ID, place of registration (country/province/city) and economic code.
Pressing «Create Company» creates the company record.
After creation you are taken automatically to «Company Information» with that company selected, to complete the rest of the profile (contacts, stakeholders, …).
This page only captures basic info; the other sections are completed later in «Company Information».

basicInfo.title: Basic information
basicInfo.intro: The only section on this page. It captures the minimum needed to create the company; the rest of the profile is completed afterward in «Company Information».
steps: Pick the registration date from the calendar and enter the registration number.
Enter the national ID and economic code.
Choose the place of registration in cascading order: country → province → city.
tips: Country/province/city selection is cascading; pick the country first to enable the province, then the city.
Final validation happens on the server; an error message is shown if something is missing.

operations.title: Create the company
operations.intro: At the end of the form is the «Create Company» button which creates the company and redirects you to the company information page.
tips: In this training sample the button is disabled and nothing is saved.
In the real form the button is disabled while processing to prevent a double submit.

items.q: What happens after I create the company?
items.a: You're taken automatically to «Company Information» with that company selected, to complete the other sections (emails, phones, addresses, stakeholders, …).

items.q: Why do I only see «Basic information»?
items.a: This page intentionally captures only the minimum needed to create the company; the rest of the profile is completed in «Company Information» afterward.

items.q: The province/city list is empty; what do I do?
items.a: Pick the country first so the province loads, then pick the province so the city loads.
